title: Rx Worlds Character Provenance Chain v1
description: Cryptographically verifiable provenance chain carried by every character/companion (canon section 5.1): official IP owner -> approved character package -> versioned Arena implementation -> licensed assets and behavior policy -> auditable player deployment. The chain is an ordered list of links; each link binds to its predecessor by hash so that tampering with any link invalidates every subsequent link. This schema enforces link SHAPE. Chain continuity (previous_link_hash linkage, genesis link, index ordering) and signature validity are verified procedurally by the receipt verifier (see README), exactly as the adversarial receipt-tamper tests do for RxReceipts.

id.description: Stable identifier of the character/companion/fragment this chain proves provenance for.

links.description: Ordered provenance links. Expected canonical order (canon section 5.1): ip_owner -> character_package -> arena_implementation -> asset_license -> behavior_policy -> player_deployment. asset_license and behavior_policy may be combined or omitted for Reflexion-original rosters; ordering and completeness rules beyond shape are enforced by the verifier, not by this schema.

index.description: Position in the chain. The genesis link has index 0.

id.description: Stable identity of the issuing authority (e.g. 'reflexion', an IP holder id, or a player id for player_deployment).

public_key_id.description: Identifier of the public key that must verify this link's signature.

issued_at_tick.description: Deterministic logical time (simulation tick). No wall-clock floats anywhere in provenance data.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical-JSON serialization of the payload this link attests (the package, implementation build, license, policy, or deployment record).

previous_link_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical-JSON serialization of the PREVIOUS link. The genesis link (index 0) MUST use 64 zero characters as its previous hash.

algorithm.description: Closed enum of permitted signature algorithms.

value.description: Base64-encoded signature over the canonical-JSON serialization of this link with the signature field excluded.
